title: An interesting carrier: the excellent performance of Nb2O5 in biomass hydrodeoxygenation
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4526-4553
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00544B, Review Article
Qi Chen, Hao Xu, Hao Li
Nb2O5, as a metal oxide carrier, has abundant acidic sites, significant water stability, strong redox centres, and valuable oxygen vacancies for research and development.
